    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Go - Zerolog使用入门</span>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        Zerolog 是一个可以结构化输出 JSON 格式的 Go 日志库，其特点就是高性能
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="简介">简介</h2>
<p>Zerolog 是一个可以结构化输出 JSON 格式的 Go 日志库，其特点就是高性能，名字中的 <code>zero</code> 代表零分配设计，速度非常快。</p>
<h3 id="什么是零分配设计">什么是零分配设计？</h3>
<p>在 Go 语言中，内存分配会带来一定的性能开销，频繁的内存分配和垃圾回收（GC）会影响程序性能。零分配设计的目标是在热点代码路径上尽量避免堆内存分配，从而减少 GC 压力，提升整体性能。</p>
<p>Zerolog 通过精心设计的 API 实现了这一目标：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>链式调用返回指针而非值</strong>：避免了每次调用都创建新的对象</li>
<li><strong>使用 sync.Pool 复用对象</strong>：日志事件对象会被放回池中重复利用</li>
<li><strong>避免接口类型</strong>：直接使用具体类型，消除接口调用的开销</li>
<li><strong>预分配缓冲区</strong>：减少写入时的内存分配</li>
</ul>
<p>这种设计使得 Zerolog 在高并发场景下表现出色，尤其适合对性能敏感的服务端应用。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>有人做了一个 Go 日志库 benchmark: <a href="https://betterstack-community.github.io/go-logging-benchmarks/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://betterstack-community.github.io/go-logging-benchmarks/</a>，可以看出 zerolog 相较于其它日志库，性能都是第一档的，不管是执行速度还是内存占用，表现得都非常好。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="特点">特点</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>高性能</strong>：零分配设计，极高的写入速度，对 GC 几乎无压力。</li>
<li><strong>结构化日志</strong>：默认输出 JSON 格式，便于日志系统（如 ELK、Loki）解析和检索。</li>
<li><strong>支持 context</strong>：可以在请求链路中传递和追加日志字段，实现请求级别的日志追踪。</li>
<li><strong>日志采样</strong>：对高频日志进行采样，防止日志风暴撑爆磁盘。</li>
<li><strong>Hook 机制</strong>：可在日志写入前进行拦截处理，例如发送错误日志到 Sentry。</li>
<li><strong>彩色输出</strong>：开发环境下可以启用彩色输出，提升可读性。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="安装">安装</h2>
<pre><code class="language-shell">go get github.com/rs/zerolog/log
</code></pre>
<h2 id="基本使用">基本使用</h2>
<p>Zerolog 开箱即用，无需复杂配置即可快速上手。<strong>默认输出到 stderr</strong>，日志格式为 JSON，每条日志自动包含 <code>level</code> 和 <code>time</code> 字段。</p>
<p>Zerolog 采用链式调用风格，API 设计简洁直观：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>log.Info()</code>、<code>log.Warn()</code>、<code>log.Error()</code> 等方法创建对应级别的日志事件</li>
<li><code>Str()</code>、<code>Int()</code>、<code>Float64()</code> 等方法添加自定义字段</li>
<li><code>Msg()</code> 或 <code>Msgf()</code> 方法最终输出日志</li>
</ul>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"errors"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog/log"
)

func main() {
	log.Info().Msg("hello world")
	log.Warn().Str("key1", "value1").Float64("fnumber", 12.34).Msg("this is a message")

	err := errors.New("this is an error")
	log.Error().Err(err).Str("service", "user").Msgf("couldn't start %s", "user")
}
</code></pre>
<p>运行输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">go run main.go
{"level":"info","time":"2026-03-10T20:41:01+08:00","message":"hello world"}
{"level":"warn","key1":"value1","fnumber":12.34,"time":"2026-03-10T20:41:01+08:00","message":"this is a message"}
{"level":"error","error":"this is an error","service":"user","time":"2026-03-10T20:41:01+08:00","message":"couldn't start user"}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="基本配置">基本配置</h2>
<p>可以进行一些基本配置：</p>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog/log"
)

func main() {
	// 全局设置：设置 time 字段值为 unix 时间戳
	zerolog.TimeFieldFormat = zerolog.TimeFormatUnix

	// 全局设置：设置日志级别
	zerolog.SetGlobalLevel(zerolog.DebugLevel)

	// 输出到 stdout。开发环境可以输出到 console 中，生产环境还是用默认的 JSON 比较好
	log.Logger = log.Output(zerolog.ConsoleWriter{Out: os.Stdout, NoColor: true, TimeFormat: time.RFC3339})

	// 基本日志
	log.Info().Msg("hello world")

	// 链式调用：指定类型有助于性能
	log.Warn().Str("key1", "value1").Float64("fnumber", 12.34).Msg("this is a message")
}
</code></pre>
<p>执行输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ go run main.go
2026-03-10T21:00:31+08:00 INF hello world
2026-03-10T21:00:31+08:00 WRN this is a message fnumber=12.34 key1=value1
</code></pre>
<h3 id="日志级别">日志级别</h3>
<p>Zerolog 支持以下日志级别，按严重程度从高到低排列：</p>
<table>
<thead>
<tr>
<th>级别</th>
<th>常量</th>
<th>值</th>
<th>说明</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td>panic</td>
<td><code>zerolog.PanicLevel</code></td>
<td>5</td>
<td>记录日志后调用 <code>panic()</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>fatal</td>
<td><code>zerolog.FatalLevel</code></td>
<td>4</td>
<td>记录日志后调用 <code>os.Exit(1)</code></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>error</td>
<td><code>zerolog.ErrorLevel</code></td>
<td>3</td>
<td>错误信息，不影响程序继续运行</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>warn</td>
<td><code>zerolog.WarnLevel</code></td>
<td>2</td>
<td>警告信息，潜在问题提示</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>info</td>
<td><code>zerolog.InfoLevel</code></td>
<td>1</td>
<td>一般信息，默认级别</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>debug</td>
<td><code>zerolog.DebugLevel</code></td>
<td>0</td>
<td>调试信息，开发环境使用</td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td>trace</td>
<td><code>zerolog.TraceLevel</code></td>
<td>-1</td>
<td>最详细的追踪信息</td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><strong>使用建议</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>生产环境建议设置为 <code>InfoLevel</code> 或 <code>WarnLevel</code></li>
<li>开发环境可以设置为 <code>DebugLevel</code> 便于调试</li>
<li><code>panic</code> 和 <code>fatal</code> 会中断程序，谨慎使用</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="添加调用者信息">添加调用者信息</h3>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog"
)

func main() {
	zerolog.TimeFieldFormat = time.RFC3339     // 全局设置时间格式为 RFC3339
	zerolog.TimestampFieldName = "timestamp"   // 全局设置时间字段名为 timestamp
	zerolog.MessageFieldName = "msg"           // 全局设置消息字段名为 msg
	zerolog.SetGlobalLevel(zerolog.InfoLevel)  // 全局设置日志级别为 InfoLevel

	// 创建自定义日志记录器，添加时间戳、调用者信息
	// Str("service", "backend") 可以在所有日志中添加服务名称
	logger := zerolog.New(os.Stdout).With().Str("service", "backend").Timestamp().Caller().Logger()

	logger.Debug().Msg("this is a debug message. it will not be logged")
	logger.Info().Dict("metrics", zerolog.Dict().Str("remote_addr", "1.2.3.4").Int("status", 200)).Msg("this is a metric")
}
</code></pre>
<p>执行输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ go run main.go | tail -n 1 | python3 -m json.tool
{
    "level": "info",
    "service": "backend",
    "metrics": {
        "remote_addr": "1.2.3.4",
        "status": 200
    },
    "timestamp": "2026-03-10T22:33:39+08:00",
    "caller": "/home/rainux/Documents/workspace/go-dev/zerolog-exp/main.go:21",
    "msg": "this is a metric"
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="采样---sampling">采样 - Sampling</h3>
<p>采样功能用于控制日志输出频率，防止瞬间日志风暴快速塞满硬盘。这在调试某些高频循环或处理突发流量时特别有用。</p>
<p>Zerolog 提供了多种采样器：</p>
<pre><code class="language-go">// BasicSampler: 每 N 条日志只记录 1 条
log.Sample(&amp;zerolog.BasicSampler{N: 100}).Info().Msg("High frequency log")

// BurstSampler: 每秒最多记录 N 条，超过后按给定比例采样
// 下面示例：每秒最多 100 条，超出后只记录 10%
log.Sample(&amp;zerolog.BurstSampler{Burst: 100, Period: time.Second, NextSampler: &amp;zerolog.BasicSampler{N: 10}})
</code></pre>
<p><strong>使用场景</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>调试循环中的日志，避免日志爆炸</li>
<li>高并发接口的请求日志</li>
<li>限流降级时的日志记录</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="context">Context</h3>
<p>Zerolog 原生支持 Go 的 <code>context.Context</code>，非常适合在请求链路中传递日志字段。</p>
<p><strong>工作原理</strong>：</p>
<ol>
<li><code>Logger.WithContext(ctx)</code> 将 Logger 绑定到 context 中</li>
<li><code>zerolog.Ctx(ctx)</code> 从 context 中取出 Logger</li>
<li>取出的 Logger 会携带之前设置的所有字段</li>
</ol>
<p>这种方式特别适合 Web 服务，可以在中间件中设置 <code>request_id</code>、<code>user_id</code> 等字段，然后在后续处理函数中直接使用。</p>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog"
	"github.com/rs/zerolog/log"
)

func someFunc(ctx context.Context) {
	logger := zerolog.Ctx(ctx)
	logger.Info().Msg("this is someFunc")
}

func main() {
	// 创建带 context 的 logger
	ctxLogger := log.With().Str("request_id", "1234qwer").Logger().WithContext(context.Background())

	someFunc(ctxLogger)

}
</code></pre>
<p>运行输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ go run main.go
{"level":"info","request_id":"1234qwer","time":"2026-03-10T22:49:23+08:00","message":"this is someFunc"}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="hook">Hook</h3>
<p>Hook 的作用是在日志写入前进行拦截处理，可以实现一些通用逻辑：</p>
<ul>
<li>给所有日志添加通用字段（如服务名、环境、主机名）</li>
<li>根据日志级别做不同处理（如错误日志发送到监控系统）</li>
<li>过滤敏感信息</li>
<li>实现日志路由（不同级别输出到不同目标）</li>
</ul>
<p>实现 Hook 只需定义一个结构体并实现 <code>Run(e *zerolog.Event, level zerolog.Level, msg string)</code> 方法。</p>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog"
	"github.com/rs/zerolog/log"
)

func someFunc(ctx context.Context) {
	logger := zerolog.Ctx(ctx)
	logger.Info().Msg("this is someFunc")
}

type SentryHook struct{}

func (h SentryHook) Run(e *zerolog.Event, level zerolog.Level, msg string) {
	if level != zerolog.NoLevel {
		e.Str("severity", level.String())
	}
	if level == zerolog.ErrorLevel {
		// 错误日志发送到 sentry
		log.Info().Msgf("send to sentry: %s", msg)
	}
}

func main() {
	hooked := log.Hook(SentryHook{})
	hooked.Warn().Msg("this is a WARN level message")
	hooked.Error().Msg("this is a ERROR level message")

	err := errors.New("Value error")
	hooked.Error().Err(err).Msg("some value is error")

}
</code></pre>
<p>运行输出，可以看到 hook 中的逻辑会先执行：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ go run main.go
{"level":"warn","time":"2026-03-10T23:20:17+08:00","severity":"warn","message":"this is a WARN level message"}
{"level":"info","time":"2026-03-10T23:20:17+08:00","message":"send to sentry: this is a ERROR level message"}
{"level":"error","time":"2026-03-10T23:20:17+08:00","severity":"error","message":"this is a ERROR level message"}
{"level":"info","time":"2026-03-10T23:20:17+08:00","message":"send to sentry: some value is error"}
{"level":"error","error":"Value error","time":"2026-03-10T23:20:17+08:00","severity":"error","message":"some value is error"}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="同时输出控制台和日志文件--自动轮转">同时输出控制台和日志文件 + 自动轮转</h2>
<p>在传统服务器上部署时，同时输出到控制台和日志文件是一个常见需求，并且还需要自动轮转以控制日志文件体积，防止日志撑爆硬盘资源。</p>
<blockquote>
<p>如果服务部署在 Kubernetes 或 Docker 环境，有完善的日志监控系统可以采集控制台日志，可以直接去掉输出日志文件的功能。</p>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/rs/zerolog"

	"gopkg.in/natefinch/lumberjack.v2"
)

func main() {
	consoleWriter := zerolog.ConsoleWriter{
		Out:        os.Stdout,
		NoColor:    false,                                // 输出颜色
		TimeFormat: time.RFC3339,                         // 设置时间格式
		PartsOrder: []string{"time", "level", "message"}, // 设置字段排列顺序
	}

	// 日志文件配置
	lumberjackLogger := &amp;lumberjack.Logger{
		Filename:   "logs/app.log", // 日志文件路径，lumberjack 会自动创建 logs 目录
		MaxSize:    100,            // 单个文件最大大小 (MB)
		MaxBackups: 5,              // 保留的旧文件最大数量
		MaxAge:     30,             // 文件最大保留时间 (天)
		Compress:   true,           // 是否压缩旧日志 (gzip)
		LocalTime:  true,           // 使用本地时间命名备份文件
	}

	multiwriter := zerolog.MultiLevelWriter(consoleWriter, lumberjackLogger)

	logger := zerolog.New(multiwriter).With().Timestamp().Logger()

	logger.Info().Msg("Hello, World!")
	logger.Info().Dict("metrics", zerolog.Dict().Float64("cpupercent", 51.23).Int("memoryusage", 11)).Msg("this is a metric")

}
</code></pre>
<p>执行输出：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ go run main.go
2026-03-10T21:23:33+08:00 INF Hello, World!
2026-03-10T21:23:33+08:00 INF this is a metric metrics={"cpupercent":51.23,"memoryusage":11}

$ tail logs/app.log
{"level":"info","time":"2026-03-10T21:23:33+08:00","message":"Hello, World!"}
{"level":"info","metrics":{"cpupercent":51.23,"memoryusage":11},"time":"2026-03-10T21:23:33+08:00","message":"this is a metric"}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="在-gin-中集成-zerolog">在 Gin 中集成 zerolog</h2>
<p>替代 Gin 默认的 logger 和 recovery 中间件：</p>
<pre><code class="language-go">package main

import (
	"context"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httputil"
	"os"
	"runtime/debug"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/gin-gonic/gin"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/rs/zerolog"
	"github.com/rs/zerolog/log"
)

const (
	TRACING_KEY = "traceId"
)

type TracingHook struct{}

func (h TracingHook) Run(e *zerolog.Event, level zerolog.Level, msg string) {
	ctx := e.GetCtx()
	if ctx != nil {
		if traceId, ok := ctx.Value(TRACING_KEY).(string); ok &amp;&amp; traceId != "" {
			e.Str(TRACING_KEY, traceId)
		}
	}
}

func ZeroLogMiddleware() gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		start := time.Now()
		traceID := c.GetHeader("X-Trace-ID")
		if traceID == "" {
			traceID = uuid.New().String()
		}

		ctx := context.WithValue(c.Request.Context(), TRACING_KEY, traceID)
		c.Request = c.Request.WithContext(ctx)

		c.Header("X-Trace-ID", traceID)
		c.Next()
		log.Info().Ctx(ctx).
			Str("method", c.Request.Method).
			Str("path", c.Request.URL.Path).
			Str("remote_addr", c.Request.RemoteAddr).
			Int("status", c.Writer.Status()).
			Int("response_size", c.Writer.Size()).Dur("latency", time.Since(start)).Msg("")
	}
}

func ZeroLogRecovery() gin.HandlerFunc {
	return func(c *gin.Context) {
		defer func() {
			if err := recover(); err != nil {
				// 检查是否是连接中断（broken pipe）
				var brokenPipe bool
				if ne, ok := err.(*net.OpError); ok {
					if se, ok := ne.Err.(*os.SyscallError); ok {
						if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(se.Error()), "broken pipe") ||
							strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(se.Error()), "connection reset by peer") {
							brokenPipe = true
						}
					}
				}
				// 获取堆栈信息
				stack := string(debug.Stack())

				// 获取原始请求内容
				httpRequest, _ := httputil.DumpRequest(c.Request, false)

				ctx := c.Request.Context()
				if brokenPipe {
					log.Error().Ctx(ctx).Any("error", err).Str("request", string(httpRequest)).Msg("network connection broken")
					c.Abort()
					return
				}

				log.Error().Ctx(ctx).Any("error", err).Str("stack", stack).Str("request", string(httpRequest)).Msg("recovery from panic")

				traceID, _ := ctx.Value(TRACING_KEY).(string)

				c.AbortWithStatusJSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, gin.H{
					"code":      http.StatusInternalServerError,
					"msg":       "Internal Server Error",
					"data":      nil,
					"timestamp": time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
					"trace_id":  traceID,
				})
			}

		}()
		c.Next()
	}
}

func main() {

	zerolog.TimeFieldFormat = time.RFC3339
	logger := zerolog.New(os.Stdout).With().Timestamp().Caller().Logger()
	logger = logger.Hook(TracingHook{})
	log.Logger = logger

	r := gin.New()
	r.Use(ZeroLogMiddleware())
	r.Use(ZeroLogRecovery())

	r.GET("/ping", func(c *gin.Context) {
		log.Info().Ctx(c.Request.Context()).Msg("get a ping request")

		time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
		c.String(200, "pong")
	})

	r.GET("/panic", func(c *gin.Context) {
		log.Info().Ctx(c.Request.Context()).Msg("get a panic request")
		panic("something went wrong")
	})

	r.Run("127.0.0.1:10000")
}

</code></pre>
<p>请求测试，可以看到响应头中已经包含了 TraceID：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ curl http://127.0.0.1:10000/ping -v
*   Trying 127.0.0.1:10000...
* Connected to 127.0.0.1 (127.0.0.1) port 10000
* using HTTP/1.x
&gt; GET /ping HTTP/1.1
&gt; Host: 127.0.0.1:10000
&gt; User-Agent: curl/8.14.1
&gt; Accept: */*
&gt;
* Request completely sent off
&lt; HTTP/1.1 200 OK
&lt; Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
&lt; X-Trace-Id: 22c92423-2e95-4ded-934f-f0fd51f36cc7
&lt; Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:13:40 GMT
&lt; Content-Length: 4
&lt;
* Connection #0 to host 127.0.0.1 left intact
pong
</code></pre>
<p>在服务端日志中也能看到对应的日志记录：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">{"level":"info","time":"2026-03-11T00:13:38+08:00","caller":"/home/rainux/Documents/workspace/go-dev/zerolog-exp/main.go:63","traceId":"22c92423-2e95-4ded-934f-f0fd51f36cc7","message":"get a ping request"}
{"level":"info","method":"GET","path":"/ping","remote_addr":"127.0.0.1:56540","status":200,"response_size":4,"latency":2001.158295,"time":"2026-03-11T00:13:40+08:00"}
</code></pre>
<p>再试试异常恢复功能：</p>
<pre><code class="language-shell">$ curl http://127.0.0.1:10000/panic -v
